payments.title: How you get paid, in detail.
payments.intro: Transparency about money is essential. Here's exactly how it works, from the moment the client pays to the transfer to your account.

clientPays.title: The client pays
clientPays.description: At booking time, the client pays 100% by card or Apple/Google Pay via Stripe.

escrow.title: Funds secured
escrow.description: Money is held by Stripe in an escrow account. You see the booking, but the money isn't yours yet.

delivery.title: Service delivered
delivery.description: On the day, you deliver your service. The client confirms (explicitly or automatically after D+1).

payout.title: Payout
payout.description: Stripe transfers the net amount to your IBAN in D+1 to D+3 working days. You receive a confirmation email.

card.title: Credit card
card.description: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Carte Bleue

sepa.title: SEPA bank transfer
sepa.description: To your pro IBAN, automatic after each service

delay.title: Payout delay
delay.description: D+1 to D+3 working days after service confirmation

tracking.title: Real-time tracking
tracking.description: Dashboard with the status of each payment

payments.stripeBody: We chose Stripe Connect, world leader in marketplace payments. This means your banking details never transit through tukio.one. KYC, PSD2 compliance, anti-fraud, everything is handled by Stripe directly. Your clients see a secure payment, you see your transfers arrive.

pricing.title: You only pay when you earn.
pricing.intro: No mandatory subscription at start. No hidden fees. A clear commission, automatically deducted from each booking. You see the exact amount you receive before even accepting the mission.

registration.title: Registration, listings, go live
registration.description: No fees to join the platform and publish your services.

commission.title: Commission per booking
commission.description: Automatically deducted from the client amount. All included, no overlay.

payout.title: Payout delay
payout.description: Stripe sends the transfer after service confirmation.

pricing.disclaimer: Subscription plans with reduced commission (Business, Enterprise) are planned for high-volume pros. They will be offered as options, never imposed. Details will be communicated at launch.

benefits.title: What we take care of for you.

payment.title: Payment
payment.description: Stripe Connect, managed KYC, automatic invoices, fast payouts. You get your money without chasing anyone.

trust.title: Trust
trust.description: Verified profiles, moderated reviews, tukio mediation in case of dispute. Your clients arrive reassured.

communication.title: Communication
communication.description: Built-in messaging, notifications, reminders. The entire history of each case in one place.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Availability, slot blocking, conflicts avoided automatically.

stats.title: Stats
stats.description: Conversion rate, average basket, response time. Enough to pilot your business.

admin.title: Administration
admin.description: Billing mandate, VAT management, accounting exports. Your accountant will thank us.
